claims: The Artemis II astronauts safely splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II astronauts splashed down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II astronauts splashed down at 8:07 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II astronauts' splashdown completed a 10-day mission.
The 10-day mission took the four-person Artemis II crew around the moon and back.
